reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — User input from request header 'Referer' flows to response body without sanitization. Inside doSomething, the condition (500/42)+196 > 200 evaluates to true (L64), causing bar to equal param. Finally, bar is printed to response.getWriter() (L54), exposing user input to XSS risk.
